hooks.command: F="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Applications/Claude Code/Diors-Builds}/docs/SESSION-START.md"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then cat "$F"; else echo "⚠️ SESSION-START.md NOT FOUND at $F — session-start guidance did NOT load. Tell Harkirat, and fix the SessionStart hook path in .claude/settings.local.json."; fi | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: .}}'

F="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Applications/Claude Code/Diors-Builds}/docs/diors-builds notes.md"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then base=$(awk '/^## Questions/{f=1} /^## 📍/{exit} f{print}' "$F"); n=$(printf '%s' "$base" | grep -cE '^- [^<[]'); open=$(printf '%s' "$base" | grep -E '^- [^<[]' | cut -c1-120 | head -15); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then printf 'NOTES-FILE CHECK: docs/diors-builds notes.md has %s open (unmarked) item(s) in its working sections (above the 📍 pointer section). Do NOT skip the notes file this session -- review, answer, mark, and file them per the notes workflow (project_central_notes_file memory). Truncated previews:\n%s' "$n" "$open"; fi; fi | jq -Rs 'if . == "" then empty else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:.}} end'

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Applications/Claude Code/Diors-Builds}" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && { git fetch --prune --quiet 2>/dev/null; gone=$(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short) %(upstream:track)' refs/heads | grep '\[gone\]' | cut -d' ' -f1); n=$(printf '%s' "$gone" | grep -c .); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then printf 'STALE-BRANCH CHECK: %s local branch(es) whose remote is already deleted (GitHub auto-deletes on merge) are sitting unpruned:\n%s\nThey rot because a plain git fetch does NOT prune remote-tracking refs, so git branch -a keeps listing merged work as if it were live. Prune now: confirm each PR is MERGED (gh pr list --head <branch> --state all --json number,state), then git branch -D <branch>; git fetch --prune. A merged branch should never outlive its PR -- see docs/README.md chore checklist step 8.' "$n" "$gone"; fi; } | jq -Rs 'if . == "" then empty else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:.}} end'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"[self-check] (1) FIRST ACTION: if you have NOT yet this session output the ready-to-paste /rename string + a one-line model+effort recommendation, do it now before any task content -- this is a hard gate (feedback_suggest_model_switch memory), not optional. (2) CHAPTERS: if this turn shifted into a new distinct TOPIC since the last mark, call mark_chapter now -- mark finely, one per topic, no cap. (3) JUDGMENT RULES: fix a gap you notice THIS turn rather than deferring/flagging it (working-agreement rule 9), and never assert done/synced/caught-up/matches without running the actual check first (verify before claiming)."}}'

force=$(jq -r '.tool_input.force // false'); if [ "$force" = "true" ]; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"FORCE-OVERWRITE GATE: this Artifact call sets force:true, which discards another session/author'"'"'s published version. 2026-07-25 17:03 EDT incident: force-published over an artifact whose current content was never actually viewed (WebFetch blocked, browser unauthenticated), destroying Harkirat'"'"'s prior-session work on an assumption. Confirm you have EXPLICIT go-ahead from Harkirat in this exact conversation for THIS specific overwrite -- not inferred from a complaint about a different artifact -- before proceeding."}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git tag +-a +v[0-9]'; then tag=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oE 'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1); target=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oE "v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ +[0-9a-f]{7,40}" | head -1 | awk '{print $2}'); [ -z "$target" ] && target=HEAD; cd "/Applications/Claude Code/Diors-Builds" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && { pj=$(git show "$target:package.json" 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"version": "[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4); if [ -n "$pj" ] && [ "v$pj" != "$tag" ]; then jq -n --arg t "$tag" --arg p "$pj" --arg c "$target" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:("TAG-INVARIANT GATE: you are about to create tag " + $t + " on commit " + $c + ", whose package.json reads " + $p + " -- they must match. A tag whose package.json is stale makes git show <tag>:package.json a liar; six such tags already exist (v2.33.3, v2.33.4, v2.35.0-v2.35.3) and are tracked in docs/db-deferred-list.md. Most likely cause: the merge did not actually land (gh pr merge can fail on UNSTABLE checks) and main never advanced, so you are tagging the PREVIOUS release commit -- this exact mistake happened 2026-07-27 22:10 EDT. Verify git log -1 on main shows THIS release before tagging.")}}'; fi; }; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|] *)gh pr merge'; then cd "/Applications/Claude Code/Diors-Builds" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && { git fetch origin main --quiet 2>/dev/null; changed=$(git show --name-only --pretty=format: origin/main 2>/dev/null); if ! echo "$changed" | grep -qx 'docs/CHANGELOG.md'; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:"DOC CHECK: This gh pr merge did not touch docs/CHANGELOG.md on the resulting main HEAD (checked via origin/main after fetch). Project convention (feedback_docs_at_push_time + project_git_workflow memory) says every merged PR should update the changelog unless there is a stated reason not to -- moved here from commit-time 2026-07-24 12:24 EDT since branch checkpoint commits are now free/unversioned. Confirm this was deliberate, or add the entry now, before moving on."}}'; fi; }; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|] *)gh pr merge'; then if ! echo "$cmd" | grep -q '\-\-delete-branch'; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:"BRANCH-PRUNE CHECK: this gh pr merge ran WITHOUT --delete-branch, so the merged branch survives locally (and its remote survives unless GitHub auto-delete removed it). This is exactly how 10 merged branches accumulated unpruned by 2026-07-27 21:50 EDT. Clean up before moving on: git checkout main; git branch -D <the merged branch>; git fetch --prune. Prefer gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch next time -- it does both in one step."}}'; fi; fi

today=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); content=$(jq -r '.tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // empty'); hits=$(printf '%s' "$content" | grep -F "$today"); if [ -n "$hits" ]; then bad=$(printf '%s' "$hits" | grep -vE "$today [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}"); if [ -n "$bad" ]; then jq -n --arg d "$today" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("TIMESTAMP CHECK: this edit wrote the date " + $d + " without an HH:MM TZ time next to it. Working-agreement checklist rule 10 (feedback_docs_at_push_time): every date you write in docs, memory, DEVLOG, changelogs, notes marks, or code comments needs YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM TZ. Add the time now, or -- only if it is a deliberate bare date such as a historical reference or the player-facing summary -- confirm that before moving on.")}}'; fi; fi

input=$(cat); active=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); if [ "$active" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; tp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); [ -f "$tp" ] || exit 0; last=$(grep '"type":"assistant"' "$tp" | tail -8 | jq -r '.message.content[]? | select(.type=="text") | .text' 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/"[^"]*"//g'); if printf '%s' "$last" | grep -qiE 'rather than (restructur|the fix|fixing|a proper fix|expand(ing)? scope|scope.?creep)|left [a-z ]{0,15}as-is|leav(e|ing) [a-z ]{0,15}as-is|noting (it|this) (rather than|instead of) (fix|address)|flag(ging|ged)? [a-z -]{0,20}(rather than|instead of) [a-z -]{0,20}(fix|address|scope.?creep)|instead of (the fix|fixing|restructur|properly|address)|defer(ring)? [a-z ]{0,15}(rather than|instead of) [a-z -]{0,15}fix'; then jq -n '{decision:"block",reason:"DEFERRAL-TELL in your last message -- you used language matching the working-agreement rule-9 failure mode (rather-than-fixing / left-as-is / instead-of-restructuring / noting-rather-than-fixing). FIX the gap you just noticed THIS turn instead of merely flagging or deferring it, UNLESS fixing genuinely needs info only Harkirat has or is truly out of scope -- in which case say so explicitly. Do not stop on a mere mention."}'; fi

input=$(cat); active=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); if [ "$active" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; tp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); [ -f "$tp" ] || exit 0; last=$(grep '"type":"assistant"' "$tp" | tail -8 | jq -r '.message.content[]? | select(.type=="text") | .text' 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/`[^`]*`//g'); if printf '%s' "$last" | grep -qiE 'medium-high|medium to high|low-medium|low to medium|high-max|medium-max|low-high|med-high|medium/high|low/medium|high/max|medium/max' ; then jq -n '{decision:"block",reason:"EFFORT-RANGE TELL in your last message -- feedback_suggest_model_switch memory explicitly says recommend ONE effort level, never a range (medium-high, low-to-medium, etc). This has lapsed 3 times now (2026-07-14, 2026-07-24, 2026-07-25 17:03 EDT). Restate as a single committed level -- if genuinely torn between two, pick the LOWER one and say why in one clause -- before stopping."}'; fi

input=$(cat); active=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); if [ "$active" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; tp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); [ -f "$tp" ] || exit 0; ln=$(grep -n '"role":"user","content":"' "$tp" | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1); ln=${ln:-1}; vcalls=$(tail -n +"$ln" "$tp" | grep -cE '"name":"(Bash|Grep|Glob)"'); last=$(tail -n +"$ln" "$tp" | grep '"type":"assistant"' | tail -8 | jq -r '.message.content[]? | select(.type=="text") | .text' 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$last" | grep -qiE '\ball done\b|everything.?s (done|clean|correct|working|in sync)|fully (done|documented|verified|working|synced)|properly (documented|verified|configured)|(is|are|it.?s) (verified|confirmed|clean|in sync|up to date|all set)|no (gaps|issues|residue|mistakes|problems) (found|left|remain|remains)|nothing (missed|left|forgotten|broken)|\ball (set|good|clear|clean)\b|session.?s (actually )?done|task is complete|matches (exactly|cleanly)|zero (residue|issues|matches)'; then if [ "${vcalls:-0}" -eq 0 ]; then jq -n '{decision:"block",reason:"COMPLETION-CLAIM WITHOUT EVIDENCE: your last message asserts something is done/verified/clean/in-sync/matches, but this turn shows ZERO Bash/Grep/Glob tool calls -- no actual check backs the claim. Harkirat has flagged this exact recurring pattern (having to send you to double-check and catch your own gaps every session). Before restating this claim: run the real verification (git status/diff, grep for residue, node -c, tests, etc.), look at its actual output, and only then assert completion."}'; fi; fi
